English Explanation: Numeric identifier of the operating time period.
Start and end times that delimit the operating period, expressed as HH:MM–HH:MM.
Name of the station to which the demand attributes refer.
Estimated number of passengers expected to board at the station during the period.
Estimated number of passengers expected to alight at the station during the period.
Estimated number of passengers expected to transfer at the station during the period.
Proportion of station-period demand attributable to commuter passengers.
Proportion of station-period demand attributable to business passengers.
Proportion of station-period demand attributable to leisure passengers.
Coefficient of variation describing the relative fluctuation or uncertainty of station-period demand.
